title: Sky Link
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: University freshman Ritsuki Ban, carrying regrets from his past, collides on his first day with a man who says he likes his face and turns out to be his new lecturer, Takagi. Ritsuki rebuffs the persistent professor until he sees Takagi's sad expression while looking at the sky, and the two begin to learn about each other (AniList, MU).
life_message: Seeing another person's hidden sadness can open a closed heart to love.
